Airtable

Turn structured records into a usable team workflow.

AOfficial product ↗Open in the hierarchy →
Level 4Inspect the detail

Airtable combines structured records with views, interfaces, and automations for business workflows. We can build a focused workspace for lead tracking, inventory, campaign production, or client delivery when the team needs more structure than a spreadsheet. The design includes field definitions, linked records, permissions, and clear review states so the workspace stays useful as the number of records grows.

Useful outputs

  • Structured base and linked records
  • Role-appropriate views and interfaces
  • Draft automations and operating guidance

Where we can apply it

  • Sales workspace: enquiry → owner assignment → follow-up → stage review.
  • Creative operations: brief → asset record → approval → publishing handoff.
  • Inventory control: item record → change request → reviewed update.
01

Use case 1

Track enquiries, owners, follow-ups, and pipeline stages in a shared workspace.

02

Use case 2

Manage inventory or campaign assets with linked records and review status.

03

Use case 3

Build role-specific interfaces and approved notification automations.

Inputs we need

  • Existing tables and sample operational records
  • Entity relationships and field definitions
  • User roles and approval responsibilities

Delivery sequence

  • Model tables and relationships and clean the starting data.
  • Build interfaces and approval states around the team's real tasks.
  • Review automation drafts, permissions, and record limits before activation.

Expert review points

  • Verify interface permissions and field ownership.
  • Confirm automation actions and plan limits match expected usage.

We confirm available integrations, plans, permissions, and data mapping before implementing these connection candidates.
